blueskyPosts.text:
This is what nationwide impact looks like: G & D Fab & Welding in Stark County, Ohio is building shields for some of the machines that we'll use to build the Hudson Tunnel Project.
 
Click the link to learn more about how the HTP is supporting jobs across the USA.

The Hudson Tunnel Project is creating good, long-term jobs that enable hundreds of workers to support their families. For Martin, working on the Palisades Tunnel Project provides more than just a paycheck - it offers stability and peace of mind.

The Gateway Development Commission will hold an in-person public Board Meeting on Monday, April 27, 2026, at 10:30 am. Registration and public comment information can be found here: www.gatewayprogram.org/board-meetin....

Each of the tunnel boring machines we're assembling in New Jersey consists of 96 pieces, some weighing as much as 185 tons on their own! ENR walks through the complex process of putting together these huge machines and what comes next once they're ready to launch. www.enr.com/articles/628...

Want to see what's next for the Hudson Tunnel Project? @njbiz.bsky.social takes you to the Palisades Portal construction site, where crews are assembling the tunnel boring machines that will build the first mile of the new tunnel in New Jersey.

@gothamist.com is right - there's nothing boring about the machines that will build the new train tunnel under the Hudson River. We're assembling the first two tunnel boring machines in New Jersey now. 

Learn more and see photos of the work in progress ⬇️

It's like assembling Legos, if your Legos had to be welded together and the final product was the size of a building!

@nj.com explains what goes into assembling the two tunnel boring machines that will build the first mile of the new train tunnel under the Hudson River.

A massive effort for massive machines. @spectrumnewsny1.bsky.social breaks down the process of assembling the tunnel boring machines that will break through rocks, remove debris, and construct a concrete lining for the new tunnel. 

Check it out 👇

We're making progress toward the start of tunnel boring! The two tunnel boring machines that will build the first mile of the new train tunnel into NYC are being assembled at the staging area in New Jersey now. PIX11 joined us at the construction site to see the work. www.youtube.com/watch?v=B6OI...

George has been a member of IUOE Local 825 for 25 years. Now he's leading a team working on the Palisades Tunnel Project. He and his crew are proud to show up and work hard to build one of the biggest infrastructure projects in the country.
